name: Animals
description: A coordinated collection of 30 cute animal motifs derived from the approved reference sheets and constrained to one strict shared 24-colour DMC palette for cross stitch, C2C crochet, tapestry crochet and latch-hook/rug formats.
description_es: Colección coordinada de 30 motivos de animales adorables derivados de las láminas de referencia aprobadas y limitada a una única paleta estricta de 24 colores DMC para punto de cruz, crochet C2C, tapestry crochet y alfombra/latch hook.

reference_policy.rule: The canonical matrices are derived from the user-approved animal reference sheets. Do not invent, redraw, substitute or reinterpret a motif. Pattern generation must start from the canonical matrix for that A#### design.

generation.purpose: Future reusable page-1 lifestyle images for the Animals collection.
generation.frame_requirement: Keep the craft display area empty; the renderer inserts the canonical design.
generation.post_generation_measurement: Record source dimensions and usable placement geometry after approval.
